memory_candidates: Simpson's telescoping formulas (6.7)/(6.8) over List (Proposition Atom), when transcribed literally with an unrestricted `∀ V : List` quantifier, can be FALSE for V=[] even when the paper's own usage never instantiates the empty case -- always run a quick semantic/countermodel check on the degenerate list-length-0 case before writing Lean for a 'prove by induction on the list' formula-level lemma ported from a paper; the paper's implicit nonempty-list convention is easy to silently violate in a literal Lean transcription.

Standalone task-scratch probes/*.lean files (lake env lean <file>, not registered in any lean_lib source root) cannot cross-import each other by module/namespace name even if they declare the same namespace -- genuine code reuse across a multi-dispatch probe sequence (e.g. C1 -> C2 -> C3) requires appending to the SAME physical file, not creating new files that re-declare shared definitions.
